facebook.caption:
4.9 stars. 3,160 reviews. At a beachfront restaurant in Phu Quoc.

Mai Hương Beachfront sits right on Grand World's waterfront square, Quãng Trường Biển. That rating isn't luck. Three thousand people agreed.

If you're doing Grand World, don't just walk past this one. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
